# Beelove Farm

> Climate-smart beekeeping and aquaculture. We produce raw honey, build hives and beekeeping equipment, supply catfish & tilapia fingerlings and Azolla feed, and train farmers worldwide. Orders are placed via WhatsApp.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Beelove Farm's beekeeping and fish farming enterprises.
- [About](/about): Our founding story, principles and circular-farming model.
- [Shop](/shop): Browse beekeeping and fish farming supplies.
- [Beekeeping Shop](/shop/beekeeping): Hives, bee suits, smokers, extractors and raw honey.
- [Fish Farming Shop](/shop/fish): Catfish & tilapia fingerlings, Azolla starter kits and pond advisory.
- [Beekeeping Training](/training/beekeeping): Hands-on beekeeping courses.
- [Fish Farming Training](/training/fish): Practical aquaculture training.
- [Suitability Map](/map): Tool to assess site suitability for farming.
- [Hive Sensors](/hive-sensors): IoT hive monitoring tools.
- [Field Journal](/journal): Notes and stories from the farm.
- [Contact](/contact): WhatsApp, email and farm visit details.
